entries.claim: A mismatch between the character encoding a browser uses to transmit a credential and the encoding the server uses to compare it is a candidate authentication bypass that must be probed with encoded variants of a known-bad password.
steps: Build the ladder BEFORE probing: raw, single-encoded, double-encoded, and over-long variants of the same logical value.
Send each rung with the baseline procedure (one variable changed).
